# ShadcnSpace

> Open-source Shadcn UI blocks, components, templates, and dashboard layouts built with React, Tailwind CSS, Base UI & Radix UI.

This file provides LLM-friendly entry points to documentation, blocks, components, templates, and guides.

## Overview
 
- [Shadcn Space](https://shadcnspace.com): Open-source Shadcn UI blocks, components, templates, and dashboard layouts built with React, Tailwind CSS, Base UI & Radix UI.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/shadcnspace/shadcnspace): Source code, issues, and contributions for the Shadcn Space project.
- [Blocks and Templates](https://shadcnspace.com/#ui-blocks): Entry point to browse available Shadcn UI blocks and templates.

## Blocks

### Dashboard UI

- [Charts Component](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/charts-component): Chart components built with Recharts, including bar, line, area, and pie charts.
- [Dashboard Shell](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/dashboard-shell): Base dashboard layout with sidebar navigation and header.
- [Dialog](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/dialog): Dialog and modal blocks with accessible focus and keyboard handling.
- [Forms](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/forms): Form blocks using React Hook Form, TanStack Form, and Zod validation.
- [Sidebar](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/sidebars): Responsive sidebar navigation blocks for dashboards.
- [Statistics](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/statistics-component): Statistic and metric card blocks for dashboards.
- [Tables](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/tables): Data table blocks built with TanStack Table.
- [Topbars](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/topbars): Dashboard header and top navigation blocks.
- [Widgets](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/dashboard-ui/widgets-component): Widget blocks for KPIs and dashboard metrics.

### Marketing

- [Hero Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/hero-section): Hero section blocks for landing pages.
- [Feature Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/feature-section): Feature showcase blocks for products and services.
- [Pricing Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/pricing-section): Pricing comparison blocks for plans and tiers.
- [CTA Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/cta-section): Call-to-action blocks to prompt user actions.
- [Navbar Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/navbar-section): Navigation bar blocks for websites.
- [Footer Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/footer-section): Footer layout blocks for links and site information.
- [Testimonials Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/testimonials-section): Testimonial and review blocks for social proof.
- [FAQ Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/faq-section): FAQ blocks for question and answer layouts.
- [Team Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/team-section): Team introduction blocks with member profiles.
- [Services Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/services-section): Service listing and offering blocks.
- [Portfolio Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/portfolio-section): Portfolio showcase blocks.
- [Blog Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/blog-section): Blog listing and article preview blocks.
- [Contact Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/contact-section): Contact form and contact information blocks.
- [Newsletter Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/newsletter-section): Newsletter signup blocks.
- [Logo Cloud](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/logo-cloud): Logo cloud blocks for partners and clients.
- [Gallery](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/gallery): Image and media gallery blocks.
- [About Us Section](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/about-us-section): About us and company story blocks.

### Authentication

- [Login](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/login): Login form blocks for authentication flows.
- [Register](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/register): Signup and registration form blocks.
- [Forgot Password](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/forgot-password): Password recovery blocks.
- [Verify Email](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/verify-email): Email verification and OTP blocks.
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://shadcnspace.com/blocks/marketing/two-factor-authentication): Two-factor authentication blocks.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://shadcnspace.com/components/accordion): Expandable accordion component for grouped content.
- [Animated List](https://shadcnspace.com/components/animated-list): Animated list component for notifications and events.
- [Animated Text](https://shadcnspace.com/components/animated-text): Text animation components including typing, gradient, and shimmer effects.
- [Apple Dock](https://shadcnspace.com/components/apple-dock): macOS-style dock component with magnification effects.
- [Avatar](https://shadcnspace.com/components/avatar): Avatar component for user profiles and identity.
- [Badge](https://shadcnspace.com/components/badge): Badge component for labels and status indicators.
- [Button](https://shadcnspace.com/components/button): Button component with variants, sizes, and states.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://shadcnspace.com/components/dropdown-menu): Dropdown menu component with support for labels, shortcuts, and submenus.
- [Calendar](https://shadcnspace.com/components/calendar): Calendar and date picker components.
- [Card](https://shadcnspace.com/components/card): Card component for structured content layouts.
- [Checkbox](https://shadcnspace.com/components/checkbox): Checkbox input component with accessible states.
- [Input](https://shadcnspace.com/components/input): Text input component for forms.
- [Marquee](https://shadcnspace.com/components/marquee): Infinite scrolling marquee component.
- [Orbiting Circles](https://shadcnspace.com/components/orbiting-circles): Circular orbit animation component.
- [Radio Group](https://shadcnspace.com/components/radio-group): Radio group component for single-choice selection.
- [Select](https://shadcnspace.com/components/select): Select dropdown component with keyboard navigation.
- [Switch](https://shadcnspace.com/components/switch): Toggle switch component.
- [Tabs](https://shadcnspace.com/components/tabs): Tabbed interface component.
- [Textarea](https://shadcnspace.com/components/textarea): Multi-line text input component.
- [Tooltip](https://shadcnspace.com/components/tooltip): Tooltip component for contextual information.

## Templates

- [Templates](https://shadcnspace.com/templates): Free and open-source Shadcn UI templates.
- [Crypgo](https://shadcnspace.com/templates/crypgo): Crypto and Web3 landing page template.
- [Resume](https://shadcnspace.com/templates/resume): Resume and portfolio template.
- [Typefolio](https://shadcnspace.com/templates/typefolio): Personal portfolio template.
